name: Crazy Alien Video Game Shop - Creative Core
author: Padd_
description:
How to play ?
• Use WASD or Directional keys to move (Shift key to run).
• Switch cameras by pressing 'CTRL' key (or Settings menu).
• Turn on the sound to better enjoy the experience and fullscreen mode!
• Switch lights to change the atmosphere in Settings menu (pressing F or 'ESC' keys).

What to do ?
• Move around the video game store to meet the NPCs and enjoy the beautiful view, but above all do not click on the button!
